caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale using pencil or graphite on a light beige background. It features a central, three-dimensional object resembling a chalice or a trophy with a wide circular base that narrows at the stem, then widens into a cup-shaped upper portion with a slightly domed lid. Emerging from the center of the lid are two straight, cylindrical rods pointed upward at an angle. The object is shaded to indicate a metallic or reflective surface and gives a sense of volume and depth. In the upper left corner of the drawing is a small, rectangular inset with a simplified line drawing of the same object, including vertical and horizontal dimension lines, and small handwritten symbols or notations. The main composition occupies the center of the paper, framed by a simple pencil rectangle. The page shows slight discoloration and small stains, especially near the edges.
title: Camphene Lamp
